prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a two-storey old stone meeting hall of the village storytellers in a small old hill village of farmers and storytellers. roof so overgrown with thick green moss and small ferns that the shingles barely show walls of large grey cut stone blocks. Windows have small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light). The whole image is 272 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: EDIT the attached layout guide into ONE finished game sprite. Treat the attached image as a STRICT pixel-coordinate layout mask/reference, not loose inspiration. Output with transparent alpha background replacing ALL magenta. Final sprite proportions 272 x 256 art pixels, nearest-neighbor uniform crisp square pixels (guide displayed at 7x). Classic JRPG 3/4 top-down orthographic: broad roof viewed from above filling precisely the upper green rectangle, front wall straight-on filling precisely the lower gray rectangle. Keep EXACT outer silhouette, roof-to-wall boundary, all FOUR yellow window rectangle positions AND dimensions and the original dark brown door rectangle at the very bottom at ground level exactly where it is in the guide, same dimensions: preserve a functioning walk-through door, do not relocate any opening. The guide is authoritative even if lower part of it appears cropped in preview. Two-storey old village storytellers' stone meeting hall: roof heavily carpeted with thick varied green moss and small discernible ferns, only tiny glimpses of old shingle courses; delicate restrained eaves along the prescribed roof boundary. Front wall made from large hand-cut irregular but orderly gray stone blocks with clear mortar seams, highlights warm ochre-gray, recesses purple-gray. Four existing windows must retain positions and shape, with small geometric leaded panes glowing warm amber as the ONLY luminous elements; subtle stone sills and dark timber frames immediately around them. Door is dark brown paneled wooden door in its original bottom position and exact size. Optional modest stone chimney rising into top transparent margin, tasteful weathering, no signs or writing. Premium hand-placed HD pixel art with medium-size clean 3–10 square pixel color clusters, no tiny noisy details, strictly no antialias, blur, soft brushes, gradients, texture noise, or checkerboard dithering. Earthy rich hue-shifted 4–6 shades per material. Neutral soft even overcast evening light upper left; no cast shadow, night filter, pools of light, or vignette. Isolated building only, transparent negative space, absolutely no ground or people. Faithfully match guide geometry above all else.
